messages:
maria_cs: Quick sync — Acme's vendor risk form just came back. They want our BYOK/key provenance flow + KMS vendor list. Can we share a standard artifact or do they need a custom write-up?

leo_se: I can grab the BYOK attestation doc. Is this for Hosted only or also Dedicated?

maria_cs: Hosted for now, Dedicated later maybe. They also asked for a simple network boundary diagram and key rotation cadence. Need to respond by EOD Friday.

amanda_pm: We have a condensed BYOK/SOC2 attestation in Confluence (internal link). It covers KMS vendors, rotation cadence, and high-level provenance. Link: https://redwood-internal/confluence/security/byok-attestation :lock:

leo_se: OK pulling the latest PDF. Note: will redact internal debug notes and any private service-account snippets. Plan to export as PDF + a PNG diagram.

maria_cs: Good — customer prefers a single ZIP with files + one-page summary. Can we include a blow-by-blow on who holds keys vs. who can request rotation? Keep it non-technical.

amanda_pm: One-pager template exists. TL;DR: we manage customer data encryption at rest, keys are in customer-scoped KMS (BYOK) or our managed KMS with tenant isolation. Rotation cadence: 90 days default; emergency rotation process described. Add that we do not persist private key material for customer-managed keys.

infra-bot: deploy-notice: security-docs-bundle v2026.03 uploaded to internal share (https://files.redwood/secdocs/v2026.03).

leo_se: Dropped files to shared drive: files/1771234567/byok-attestation.pdf and files/1771234567/byok-flow.png. Also included a redacted example of the key rotation job command: `./ops/rotate-keys --tenant acme --dry-run`

vince_cust: @maria_cs thanks — tight timeline but we can accept draft and follow up with questions. EOD Friday is fine.

maria_cs: Sent the ZIP to Acme at 16:42 with the one-pager and attestation PDF. Included a short note: "Attached is our BYOK attestation and a simple diagram of the key flow. Happy to do a 30-min walkthrough."

amanda_pm: I'll schedule a 30-min walkthrough next Tue morning to cover BYOK vs Managed KMS and Dedicated migration options.

maria_cs: Closing loop here. If they ask for sample KMS audit logs, we'll escalate to Security for a controlled redaction set. Reopen thread if needed. :white_check_mark:
